recipes.RET: robust z of raw simple return (burn-in median/IQR, clip +/-8)
recipes.RET_CS_IN: exact duplicate of RET_CS under a distinct name so a run can list it in --input_parameter_names while RET_CS stays in --output_parameter_names (safe default: one column in both lists is unverified in the C++)
recipes.ILLIQUIDITY: abs(raw signed Amihud) -> trailing 21-day mean (expanding first 20 rows) -> log (floor 1e-15) -> per-date cross-sectional rank in [-1,1]
recipes.REV21_1: prod(1+r)-1 over rows i-20..i-1, EXCLUDES today (0.0 while <2 prior rows) -> per-date cross-sectional rank in [-1,1]
recipes.TURN_RATIO: mean(log1p(max(TURNOVER,0)), rows i-4..i) - mean(same, rows i-62..i), expanding starts -> per-date cross-sectional rank in [-1,1]
recipes.VOL21: sample std of raw RET over rows i-20..i (0.0 when <2 obs) -> per-date cross-sectional rank in [-1,1]
recipes.RET_CS: per-date cross-sectional rank-normal of raw RET: Phi^-1((avg_rank - 0.5)/N), N = n_stocks; contemporaneous, leak-free
recipes.RET_CS_Z: per-date cross-sectional z-score of raw RET: (r - mean_t)/sd_t (population sd), clip +/-8
recipes.RET_CS5: FORWARD-LOOKING TARGET: prod(1+r)-1 over rows i+1..i+5 -> per-date cross-sectional rank-normal Phi^-1((avg_rank - 0.5)/N); last 5 rows of the panel are 0.0 placeholders (they fall outside any scored window); NEVER a feature/input

raw_returns.note: RET is now normalized in the per-stock CSVs, so the raw simple returns needed for realized-return / trading-book scoring live in panel_dates.csv as RET_raw_<TICKER>, in the same stock order as PRC_/TC_ (sorted ticker order). RET can also be de-normalized as raw = z * stats.RET.iqr + stats.RET.median, but only where z is unclipped.

no_lookahead: all pooled normalization statistics come from rows dated <= 2019-12-31 (a strict prefix of the panel, 3872 of 5130 rows); every cross-sectional transform reads only same-date values; every time-axis FEATURE transform (Amihud mean, REV21_1, TURN_RATIO, VOL21) is trailing-only; the single exception is the RET_CS5 TARGET, which is forward-looking by construction
forward_looking_warning: RET_CS5 is the ONLY forward-looking column in this panel: it is built from returns at rows i+1..i+5 and is a TARGET for --output_parameter_names ONLY. It must NEVER appear in --input_parameter_names or any feature list. The last 5 rows of the panel carry 0.0 placeholders for RET_CS5 (their forward window runs off the panel; they fall outside any scored window). RET_CS_IN is a safe input-side duplicate of RET_CS.
